shots.prompt: Premium editorial tailoring campaign from this real studio photograph. Preserve the same beige tailored jacket lapels, seams, sleeve length, buttons and matching trousers on the seated adult model. Tight fabric-focused framing, a restrained one-centimeter lateral camera slide. The fabric moves only subtly with natural breathing while the model remains seated. Original warm directional studio light and brown background, tactile weave, refined shadow detail. No changes to garment cut, no new buttons or accessories, no logo, no text, no extra hands, no cut. No voices or music.
